ic_name: MIPI DSI v1.01.00 (Display Serial Interface, MIPI Alliance)

spec_provided_observability.name: Long Packet Checksum
spec_provided_observability.purpose: CRC-16 poly x^16+x^12+x^5+1, init 0xFFFF, LSB-first; payload coverage.

spec_provided_observability.name: Acknowledge and Error Report
spec_provided_observability.purpose: 16-bit Error Report mask returned via Short Packet DT=0x02 after BTA.

spec_provided_observability.name: Acknowledge Trigger Message
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Single-byte LP trigger 0x21 sent by peripheral when no errors stored.

spec_provided_observability.name: BTA (Bus Turn-Around)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: LP Escape Mode-based explicit ownership handover.

spec_provided_observability.name: Tearing Effect (TE) trigger 0x5D
spec_provided_observability.purpose: LP Escape trigger from Command Mode peripheral; safe-to-write signal.

error_detection_mechanisms: Hamming-modified header ECC: single-bit correct / 2-bit detect.
Payload CRC-16 on Long Packets; 0xFFFF for zero-length payload; 0x0000 from non-checksum peripheral.
Acknowledge and Error Report Short Packet (DT=0x02 reverse) — 16-bit error mask.
HRX_TO / HTX_TO / LTX-P_TO / LRX-H_TO contention-recovery timers.
LP-Contention detector (LP-CD on bidirectional Data Lane 0) per §7.2.1 + Annex A.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: 1-bit header error corrected; Error Report bit 8 set.
2-bit header error; packet dropped; bit 9 set.
DT not defined / implemented; bit 11 set.
VC field not recognized; bit 12 set.
Expected EoTp / BTA not received; bit 15 set.
Peripheral sends LP trigger 0x5D after BTA.

notes: DSI v1.01.00 inherits ECC + Checksum integrity machinery from CSI-2 / D-PHY but adds a peripheral-to-host reverse channel for explicit error reporting, plus the EoTp Short Packet as a protocol-layer end-marker independent of D-PHY EoT. The Tearing Effect trigger 0x5D is a DSI-only addition over CSI-2 — it replaces the dedicated TE pin of parallel DBI-2 interfaces with an in-band LP escape signaling sequence.
error_clearing_rule: Errors shall be accumulated by the peripheral during single or multiple transmissions and only cleared after they have been reported back to the host. Errors are transmitted as part of an Acknowledge and Error Report Short Packet after the next BTA from the host.
error_isolation_caveat: Since errors accumulate across multiple transmissions before the next BTA, the host may be unable to associate a particular error to the specific transmission causing it. If per-transmission error attribution is required, software shall send individual packets in separate transmissions, each followed by BTA.
